feeding_claim.verbatim: Here on our farm we raise 100% grass-fed, grass finished beef cattle, and pastured, forage-fed, non-GMO pork.

resold_note: Also sells eggs from Ridge Lane Farm, raw cow, goat and sheep dairy from partner dairies, some partner-raised chicken, and produce, bread and pantry goods from other local producers.
notes: Run by Ryan and Katrina Schrock since 2014. The farm's own domain is vintagemeadows.farm (named on the about page) but only the squarespace address appeared in search and loaded, so it is used as the website; recheck. Read the homepage, about us, quality standards, pasture-raised meat and eggs, real dairy, veggies and more, delivery, shipping, Goshen farm pickup, pickup locations and membership pages (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote; the homepage words it slightly differently: '100% grass-fed beef cattle, and pastured, forage-fed & non-GMO pork'). Beef: cattle eat pasture in warm months and organically grown hay in winter; about 99% of beef is raised on the farm, with some feeder calves bought from partner farms and finished here. Pork is pastured but fed non-GMO grain; poultry gets non-GMO corn and soy feed; lamb is 100% grass-fed. Chicken is partly raised by partner families. Eggs (Ridge Lane Farm, New Paris) and all dairy (Forest Grove Dairy and others in Middlebury and Shipshewana; raw milk with a 'not for human consumption' notice) come from other farms, so dairy is not listed. Buying requires a $35 yearly membership and signed membership and share agreement. Farm pickup in Goshen Thursdays and Fridays by preorder only (not a public storefront). Every-other-week delivery routes to Chicago-area suburbs and Northwest Indiana towns listed as pickup points (page gives no states; Crown Point, Munster are Indiana, the rest Illinois). UPS shipping only to Northwest Indiana: much of LaPorte County, Portage, Chesterton, Michigan City, Valparaiso and nearby areas. No quarter, half or whole shares found. No phone on the site; email info@vintagemeadows.farm.
